answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Awarded emergency planner registration with emergency planning attestation stops them at the door: a registration planning officers renew after exercise audits, which means the nadir of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the pearl is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the terrace for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
